segments.name: Simulators and Accessories
segments.description: Sells VirTra training simulators and accessories, including recoil kits, return fire devices and refills, to law enforcement and military.
segments.evidence: Simulators and Accessories- These include all variations of the VirTra simulator, Simulated recoil kits, Return first devices, Taser©, OC Spray, low light devices and refill options.

segments.name: Extended Service-type warranties
segments.description: Sells extended service-type warranties covering products beyond their standard first year.
segments.evidence: Extended Service-type warranties – Warranties on all products past 1 or more years

segments.name: Customized software and Custom content
segments.description: Designs custom content and software for specific customers under individual contracts with those customers.
segments.evidence: Customized software and Custom content- Contracts with specific suppliers who have ask for content related directly to their situations that we design and film or specific software request for there system only

segments.name: Installation and Training
segments.description: Installs simulators at customer sites and provides extra training classes onsite, virtually, or at the training center.
segments.evidence: Installation and Training – Installation of our simulators at the specific sites as well as extra training classes preformed onsite, virtually or at the VirTra Training Center

segments.name: Design and Prototyping
segments.description: Performs hardware development under specific contracts for individual customers.
segments.evidence: Design and Prototyping – Specific contracts related to hardware development for specific customers

segments.name: STEP
segments.description: Lets agencies use simulator products and V-VICTA coursework on a subscription basis.
segments.evidence: Subscription Training Equipment Partnership (STEP)™ is a program that allows agencies to utilize VirTra's simulator products, accessories, and V-VICTA interactive coursework on a subscription basis.

revenueModel.text: Government agencies, and commercial buyers through prime contractors, pay for simulators, related products, services and subscriptions.
revenueModel.evidence: Commercial customers include selling through prime contractors for military or law enforcement contracts, domestically.
